notes.title: Cubic Cosmos Patch Notes v0.13.39
notes.content: [p]Hail, Cosmonauts! See below for details on update v0.13.39:[/p][p][b]Update Time:[/b] 2025/9/23 15:00 UTC[/p][p][/p][olist][*][p]The Difficulty 9 starting Relic Ninth Cosmic Seal has been reworked, and now grants a Health buff to certain Heroes.[/p][olist][*][p]High Infernal gains Lasting +0/+10 from their first battle when using the hero skill Madness. Grand Arcaness gains Lasting +0/+10 from their first battle when using the hero skill Surge.[/p][/*][*][p]This will serve as a fundamental buff mechanic within the game for subsequent runs at different difficulties following changes to archetypes in the latest version.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p]Enhanced hero High Infernal's variant deck, replacing Less is More with Bloody Strike.[/p][/*][*][p]Ardent Knight will no longer appear during the first turn when fighting Mega Shockerel in Mastery Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced Dolls Gobbo, Leafy, and Skelly. Cards hidden within them will gain +30% Might (Gobbo), +20% Health (Leafy), or +20% Potency (Skelly) at the start of battle. This buff applies to battle only, and does not affect the card's rating.[/p][/*][*][p]When Magick Brush is used to Discover pawns, the pawn loses -1 MP cost.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Magman's starting Health from 8 to 9.[/p][/*][*][p]Relic Sacred Chalice now buffs Temp Relic cards in your deck as well as in your hand.[/p][/*][*][p]Relic Legion Banner's secondary effect triggers when you have ≥15 cards in your deck (previously ≥20).[/p][/*][*][p]Relic Sunstone now has the Boost trait.[/p][/*][*][p]Empower and Invigorate traits now have effects similar to Boost.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where complex skill interactions would cause card models to remain in your hand.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Magma Drake's skill would cause Enchanted Vines's card to remain on the screen when summoned.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you could select 2 Dolls at the same time. This issue was somewhat complex, and could appear when logging in for a first time after an update and selecting a Doll different to the one previously selected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where enemy cards obtained through completing events did not have tier II effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Relic panel could display Relics in the wrong places when there were multiple Relics.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple issues with UI blocking and trait explanation tooltip locations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where negative values could appear in the run summary screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Dolls could have excessive numbers of Doll traits.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved and fixed a number of issues with controllers. Controller support remains in development.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Thank you once again for your feedback![/p]

notes.title: Cubic Cosmos Demo Now Available! Win Product Keys With Community Events
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444613/6cc8158f9feb61303ad139af86c1ce69cc197664.jpg[/img]

Hail, Cosmonauts!
The new Cubic Cosmos demo is now available!

We've made a number of improvements to the game based on your feedback following the first demo. Thank you to all our playtesters for your suggestions!

[h3]Major changes in the demo include:[/h3]
[olist]
[*]Improved level pacing and deck upgrade experience.
[*]Improved cards and enemies to increase strategic depth and playability, clarifying gameplay systems and strengthening differences between classes.
[*]Improved the Doll system.
[*]Improved interactions, making them more intuitive and less burdensome.
[*]Overhaul of sound effects.
[*]Added "Fast Mode" for battles, which can be enabled in the settings.
[*]Added Blue-class (Magician) hero card with the Shapeshift trait. Events will also offer you Magician cards.
[/olist]Following the release of the demo, we'll continue to keep a close eye on community feedback, and carry on with regular bug fixes and improvements.

[h3]Community Event: Recommend Cubic Cosmos to Win a Product Key![/h3]
[b]Event Duration[/b]: June 1 2025 - June 17 2025
[b]How to Participate[/b]:
[olist]
[*]Visit our Steam page, add Cubic Cosmos to your wishlist, and take a screenshot including the game name and the "on wishlist" notification.
[*]Post your screenshot on X, Facebook, Instagram or Bluesky along with a few words of recommendation (the more authentic, the better!)
[*] Send a link to your post to our [b]Discord moderator[/b]
[*]We'll choose 10 lucky winners to receive a product code when the event ends.
[*]Product keys will be sent by DM when the game is released. Keep an eye out for messages from mods.
📢 Visit our [url=https://discord.gg/M8GhQ9Cajs]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Cubic Cosmos is Part of June's Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444613/85f773e9861e14e861feff04fceb073ff4ec79e6.png[/img]

Hail, Cosmonauts!
The Cubic Cosmos demo has now been online for one week! Thank you for playing, and thanks for your feedback and suggestions, which have helped us to uncover many issues and make a number of improvements. Over the past few days, we've continued to release fixes to improve your gaming experience.
[b]The current demo will be available until May 6[/b]. If you haven't experienced Cubic Cosmos yet, now's your chance—and please feel free to provide your feedback and suggestions!

[b]The next demo will be released as part of June's Steam Next Fest[/b], and will include a major update to the game. The current plan is as follows:
1. Releasing Blue cards (magic) in select scenarios, adding more enemies, bosses, and Relics.
2. Improving stage pacing and deckbuilding experience, increasing strategic depth and enjoyment.
3. Fully implementing finished art assets and replacing all placeholder cards.
4. Differentiating the gameplay experience for different heroes.
5. Improving the Doll system to make obtaining and using Dolls more convenient.
6. Improving interactions for more intuitive gameplay and a smoother experience.
7. Complete overhaul and upgrade of sound effects.

We're working hard to polish the game, and we hope you'll enjoy a more complete and even more fun version of Cubic Cosmos as part of Steam Next Fest!
If you've liked the game so far, don't forget to add Cubic Cosmos to your wishlist. You'll be notified as soon as the Next Fest demo is available!

notes.title: Cubic Cosmos Demo Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hail, future Cosmonauts! We're Inkstone Atelier, an independent game studio based in Chengdu, China.
Back in 2023, we released our first game, Looper Tactics. It's a game that left us with mixed feelings; it failed to recoup its costs, but we were delighted to see the positive reception it got. It's that support from our players—which has always been the most important thing to us—that has kept us making games.
Not long after, while working on our second game, we caught a lucky break. Looper Tactics caught the attention of Lilith Games, and they offered to support us. With renewed confidence and more resources than ever before, we knuckled down and dedicated all of 2024 to working on our new title: Cubic Cosmos.

After over a year of hard work, [b]Cubic Cosmos will debut its first demo as part of Eastern Game Fest[/b]. We're pretty nervous, but also extremely excited to see what you think of it.

We wanted to write a devlog to share our development journey and our design philosophy. If you have anything to say about the gameplay, setting, or anything else we share, we'd love to discuss it with you! You can leave your thoughts in the comments or join our [url=https://discord.gg/M8GhQ9Cajs]official Discord[/url].

[h3]What Kind of Game Do We Want to Make?[/h3]
Cubic Cosmos is a strategic roguelike deckbuilder. In a crowded genre, we know that innovation is what'll make or break this game. Most deckbuilders on the market right now are modeled after Hearthstone or Slay the Spire—we want to break out of that framework.
In the early stages of the project, we focused on what new ideas we could bring to the table. We settled on what we're calling "falling card combat". Kind of like Tetris, but with slavering monsters coming at you instead of tetrominoes. We wanted a game that was easy to jump into, but also had enough depth and progression elements to reward players who synergized and strategized.
Our previous game mostly centered on buffing your minion cards as much as possible and slugging it out with your enemy. With Cubic Cosmos, we've added tons of new effects and mechanics, unlocking a huge variety of new playstyles and making every run unique.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444613/ea5cc698b7391bf5502957058d76d57ee3ccbbe2.png[/img]

[h3]Old Tricks, New Art[/h3]
There's an old adage here in China, one that most indie game devs will probably agree with: Poverty breeds innovation. Even with our limited resources, we've always tried to improve our visuals in clever ways.
During a visit to the Sichuan Museum, we were struck by their collection of Han dynasty "portrait bricks". It got us thinking: Why do cards need to be "flat"? With that in mind, we tried using traditional art techniques to give our 2D card art more depth and dimensionality. These 2D models are placed on separate "background plates". When a card attacks, its 2D model separates from its background plate and pops out, then rams into its target with a satisfying impact.
The few folks who have tested the game thus far have said they really liked the feeling of blowing up enemies, which counts as a success in our books. It's a bit of ingenuity to get around limited resources, but we're happy with the results... unless one of you wants to give us 100 million dollars, in which case we'll do 3D models for every card (kidding but also not really kidding).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444613/504dcef46aa62d949ca0c5865aef916c469f61ec.png[/img]

[h3]Development Progress[/h3]
During the development of our last game, mostly due to our lack of experience, we frequently encountered fundamental architectural problems. We lost a lot of valuable time changing and fixing things we already thought were settled. 
Here's another colorful Chinese adage for you: Every pit you fall into is a lesson learned (it sounds snappier in Chinese, honest). We're happy to inform you that development is going a lot smoother this time around. With our improved devtools and processes, we've saved a lot of time that we can spend on design and debugging.
As for the visual side of things, our artists have been hard at work. We've already got a whole gallery's worth of card art, running the gamut from cool to beautiful to adorable. We can't wait for you to see it all!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444613/b66464e5018397000e7a03592317ee39b5c1f38c.png[/img]

[h3]Demo Coming Soon[/h3]
We're hard at work putting the finishing touches on the first demo for Cubic Cosmos. If all goes to plan, you'll be able to play the demo next week.
If you're interested in our game, don't forget to add Cubic Cosmos to your Wishlist, and please feel free to leave any feedback and suggestions you have once you've played the demo. Thanks for your support, and we'll see you soon!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444613/05e08d73ccbf975881674030fea76092053afe50.png[/img]
